title: Petals of Reincarnation
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Touya Senji, haunted by a lack of talent, learns that his classmate Haito draws on her past life as the swordsman Miyamoto Musashi by cutting her own throat with an artifact. Touya joins the 'Forest of the Greats', Returners who borrow great figures' talents, to fight the 'Sinners', who resurrect infamous historical figures. The story explores identity and whether to embrace a past life or forge one's own future.
life_message: Worth is not the same as talent, and a person must choose who to become rather than live off the greatness of others.
